androidOciFeasibility.reason: The Android project sets org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx4g; emulator/macrobenchmark is a managed-device path and needs additional RAM, CPU, nested virtualization/KVM, SDK system images, and disk headroom. Always Free OCI should not start emulator jobs until host readback proves capacity.
safeOciCoverageWithoutEmulator: Gradle compile/unit/lint when memory headroom is proven
Paparazzi only when explicitly opted in and storage headroom remains safe
